title: Phase6B a P4_reuse_features
text:
Task: build MOR then KOR Ki activity models on the shared 100k library, and reuse the molecular feature cache across the two targets where that is legitimate.

Data:/n- MOR labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprm1/ki/dataset.csv
- KOR labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprk1/ki/dataset.csv
- split manifests: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/{oprm1,oprk1}/ki/split_manifest.json
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi

Deliverable: both models trained, both topK files written, and a note on what was reused.
note: held-out pitfall variant: must NOT enter the experience store
